uniform.description: Every value from min to max is equally likely. Off, values near the middle come more often.

per_path.label: once per path
per_path.description: One value for every path, the same in every node that reads it, like the age of a mushroom that its stipe, its cap and how far the cap opens all read. Off, every read draws a new value.

once.label: once for the graph
once.description: One value for the whole graph, the same in every node and on every path that reads it, like the size of a single mushroom that its stipe, its cap and the pattern on its cap all read. Wins over once per path.
